neu.name: Claude Platform Release Notes
zeilen: * We’ve deprecated [fast mode](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/fast-mode) for Claude Opus 4.8, with removal on November 30, 2026. After removal, requests to `claude-opus-4-8` with `speed: "fast"` will return an error. To continue using fast mode, migrate to [Claude Opus 5.5](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/opus-5-5/migration-guide#migrating-from-claude-opus-4-8). Read more in [Fast mode model availability](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/fast-mode#supported-models).
